SUPERSESSION_NOTE: The central claim of this record — global contraction toward a SINGLE attractor — was tested directly in DISCOVERY-006 and REFUTED. The contraction ratio is constant at 0.5-0.7 across six orders of magnitude and perturbed endpoints reach equally-good but functionally distinct solutions. The correct statement is a connected continuum of solutions, not a single attractor. This record is preserved unedited so the correction is auditable.
claim: The seven failures are not seven unlucky searches. They are one structural fact with seven consequences: in every feed-forward supervised system this program has examined, the functional dynamics are globally contracting toward a SINGLE attractor. Every phenomenon searched for requires multiple stable functional fates, and that precondition is absent by construction.
direction_changing_consequence: The canalization, bifurcation, phase-transition, criticality and geometric-phase family cannot be studied in single-learner feed-forward supervised systems, because the object those theories describe does not exist there. Continuing to search this class is not merely unpromising; it is structurally excluded. Any continuation must move to systems where multiplicity of functional fate is guaranteed by construction rather than hoped for: interacting populations with competition, or tasks with discrete solution sets.
eliminated: DISCOVERY-001 transport boundary (falsified on nonlinear systems, FAIL-007)
curriculum holonomy / geometric phase (no area scaling)
evidence_that_it_is_structural_not_incid: Antisymmetric Hessian curvature at the symmetric solution is POSITIVE in all 12 swept cells (width 4/16/64 x feature-noise 0.1/0.6/2/6). A pitchfork requires a sign change; there is none.
Zero bimodal functional outcomes across five system families and roughly 46 configurations, verified by max-gap/range rather than thresholds.
Perturbed replicas converge: final functional spread stays within a factor of two of its early value (log ratio range 0.31 to 0.35 decades).
Full-batch descent preserves an exact discrete symmetry to 1e-16; SGD breaks it but the broken mode is soft-and-stable, never ordering.
Curriculum residue shows no area dependence across an 8x area range, so there is no curvature structure in the functional dynamics either.
title: Structural cause common to seven consecutive negative results
what_this_does_not_claim: It does not claim such phenomena are absent from machine learning generally. It claims they are absent from the model class this program has been searching, and gives the structural reason.
